title: Grateful Dead Live at Euphoria Ballroom on 1970-07-16
lineage: Cassette (Sony TC-WE475) -> Sony R500 (Pass Through) -> SEK'D Prodif Plus -> Samplitude Professional v8.01 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Crisp soundboard capture of a fiery July 16 1970 show featuring Janis Joplin’s unforgettable guest spots on Lovelight and Candyman.
ai_review.review: The recording is an excellent sound‑board transfer by Charlie Miller, praised for its crystal‑clear clarity and faithful capture of stage banter. The performance shines with Janis Joplin joining the Dead on Lovelight and Candyman, plus lively moments from Jerry and Pigpen that make this night feel like a historic jam session.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently enthusiastic reviews (mostly 4‑5 stars) highlight both an outstanding musical performance and a high‑quality, crisp soundboard recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Analog‑to‑digital transfer by Charlie Miller is described as crisp and clean; no dropout or muddiness mentioned. The capture includes clear stage banter, indicating a well‑balanced mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows with high energy, punctuated by spontaneous banter (Jerry’s “Aw Fuck!”) and Janis Joplin’s memorable vocal contributions, giving the night a legendary, almost mythic feel.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His on‑stage profanity and quick‑witted banter are captured, showing his playful side before launching into the songs.
band_member_comments.Keys: Ron "Pigpen" McKernan’s organ growls and vocal contributions stand out, especially during the Janis‑filled moments.
